title: feat(approvals,messaging): approval requests, reminders and outcomes also go by e-mail, linking to the request page
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg86P83jwb8r8DKyzSynqPiY)_
Fixes #30509

domain:server#6 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CXCS98uhsFQYk64epE

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `git grep` of `skills/**` for approval notification / approval e-mail / channels / `registerBuiltinTemplates` / notification template returns 0 hits on `b8ab4808`; no metadata an author writes changes

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：审批的四种提醒（有新审批、催办、通过、驳回）除了站内信，现在同时发一封邮件。邮件标题和正文就是站内信那段话，末尾多一行「打开审批」链接，直接进应用里的审批页。站内信一个字没变，其他审批提醒仍只发站内信。
- 为什么改：cloud#2549 裁定 B 的第 ② 项。裁决第 2 条两处落点均撞约束，按 #30509 裁定走第三处落点：在消息服务里加一级「代码内置模板」，不写进数据库，组织自己在 Setup 写的模板优先。
- 风险与回滚：邮件链接要用部署地址。没配 OS_BASE_URL 或 OS_AUTH_URL 时链接退回相对路径，启动时警告一次，不会编造地址。没装邮件服务的环境里，每条审批提醒会多一行「email 渠道未注册」的告警，投递照旧走站内信。回滚就是 revert 本 PR，没有数据要迁。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-messaging/src/template-renderer.ts`（模板仓的逐级查找：同一级组织行优先，内置其次）；`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` 的 `notify()`（四个主题请求 inbox+email，只有这四个带 `approvalUrl`）；`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/public-base-url.ts`（地址从哪来，为什么不取 localhost）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run src/approval-email-notification.integration.test.ts`，预期 5 个全绿。发起、催办、通过、驳回各有一行 `email` 投递记录且状态为 success，邮件末行是 `Open the approval: https://app.example.test/system/approvals?request=...`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Approval notices for the request's own lifecycle now go by e-mail as well as to the in-app inbox. The ruling on objectstack-ai/cloud#2549 is **B** (「B 只让租户自配邮箱」), and this is its item ②. 「裁决第 2 条两处落点均撞约束，按 #30509 裁定走第三处落点」: a seeded `sys_notification_template` row is organization-owned and ADR-0131 §1.4 rules out seeding one per organization, and a plugin-email template named through `payload.template` would also re-render the inbox (`inbox-channel.ts` reads `payload.template` too) and fail the inbox delivery on a kernel with no email service. The ruling recorded on #30509 (comment 6660948916) chose a third location, a code-declared template tier in messaging, with fixed parameters. This PR builds it.

- **`@objectstack/plugin-approvals`**
  - `notify()` asks for `channels: ['inbox', 'email']` on `approval.requested`, `approval.reminder`, `approval.approved` and `approval.rejected`, in one emit. Every other `approval.*` topic still names no channel, so it stays inbox-only. Delivery preferences filter the e-mail as they filter any channel. The payload carries no `template`, so the inbox renders exactly as before.
  - Those four notices also carry a new payload member, `approvalUrl`: the same request page as `actionUrl` (`/system/approvals?request=ID`), under the deployment's public origin. `actionUrl` stays relative because the Console routes on it. `approvalUrl` opens the request page for a signed-in reader and decides nothing. It is not an ADR-0043 action link and holds no token.
  - `approval-email-templates.ts` declares the e-mail for each of the four topics in `en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES` (the approval catalog's locales). The subject is `{{title}}`. The body is `{{body}}`, a blank line, then one localized line with `{{approvalUrl}}`. Format `text`. The plugin registers them at start through `messaging.registerBuiltinTemplates` when the messaging service offers it (`ApprovalMessagingSurface` gains the optional member and `channels`).
  - `public-base-url.ts`: an unset `publicBaseUrl` option resolves from `OS_AUTH_URL` (legacy `BETTER_AUTH_URL`), then `OS_BASE_URL`, with `??` as plugin-email's template `baseUrl` reads them. ⛔ It never falls back to a guessed `http://localhost:PORT`. With nothing set, or a value that is not an absolute `http(s)` URL, links stay relative and the plugin warns once at start, naming the variables. The composition point is `ApprovalsServicePlugin.start` in `approvals-plugin.ts`, inside `plugin-approvals`.
- **`@objectstack/service-messaging`**
  - `NotificationTemplateStore` reads a code-declared tier (`BuiltinNotificationTemplates`) at every rung of its existing locale ladder: the organization's row at that rung, else the built-in at that rung, else the next rung, else the generic title and body. So an organization that authors a row overrides a built-in with nothing to migrate. A delivery with no organization, or a store with no engine, still reads the built-in (it is no organization's). A failed row read still answers `null`, never a built-in in place of a row it could not see.
  - `MessagingService.registerBuiltinTemplates(templates)` is the seam, and `MessagingServicePlugin` hands the service's tier to the email and SMS channels' shared store. A malformed template, or a `(topic, channel, locale)` already declared, is refused with a `TypeError`, and nothing from that call is kept. `BuiltinNotificationTemplate` is exported as a type. The wiring key is module-private (`TEMPLATE_BUILTINS`), like the declared fallback locale, so `NotificationTemplateStoreOptions` is unchanged.
- No `packages/spec` change: approvals reaches messaging through its own local `ApprovalMessagingSurface`. `email-channel.ts`, `email-plugin.ts`, `mail.manifest.ts` and `packages/rest/**` are untouched (#30510 owns the channel's "not configured" answer).

Files: `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/{approval-service.ts, approvals-plugin.ts, approval-email-templates.ts, public-base-url.ts}`, `packages/services/service-messaging/src/{template-renderer.ts, messaging-service.ts, messaging-service-plugin.ts, index.ts}`, their tests, one changeset.

## Tests

Run at head `9751540c` (the branch with `origin/main` merged at `b8ab4808`) unless a line says otherwise.

- **New: `approval-email-notification.integration.test.ts`** (plugin-approvals). It runs the real composition: a real `ObjectQL` over `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3, in-memory), the real `MessagingServicePlugin` with its durable outbox and dispatcher, the real `ApprovalsServicePlugin`, `OS_BASE_URL` set, and an `email` service whose transport records what it is handed.
  - Opening a step leaves an `email` delivery row in `success` beside the `inbox` one. The sent message's subject is the inbox title, and its text is the inbox body plus `Open the approval: https://app.example.test/system/approvals?request=ID`. The inbox row keeps the relative `action_url`.
  - The reminder, the approval and the rejection (with the decider's comment) each do the same for their recipient.
  - A comment (`approval.comment`) stays inbox-only.
  - ⛔ No stored row of any table, and no message sent, matches the ADR-0043 action-link shape (the regex `reminder-action-link-at-rest` uses). This is not vacuous: three mails went, and the stored notification rows carry the request link.
- **Red on main:** the new file run against `origin/main`'s sources at `1fd0c32c` (the six changed source files restored from that commit in the tree, then `git checkout HEAD --` them back, `git diff HEAD` empty): 4 failed, 1 passed. The inbox-only control is the one that passes.
- **New messaging pins** in the existing harness files, as top-level `describe` blocks: `template-renderer.test.ts` (the tier's ladder, overrides, the no-organization and no-engine reads, failed-read `null`, and every registration refusal) and `template-declared-fallback.test.ts` (the plugin composition: the email channel renders a template registered after `kernel:ready`, and an organization row overrides it).
- **New unit pins:** `public-base-url.test.ts` and `approval-email-templates.test.ts` (four topics × the catalog's four locales, holes exactly `body` then `approvalUrl`).
- **Pins updated for the new payload member.** Each adds `approvalUrl` beside the relative `actionUrl` on one of the four emailed topics. None loosens a token or link assertion:
  - `approval-service.test.ts`: the remind pin also asserts `channels: ['inbox','email']`;
  - `approval-notification-body.integration.test.ts`: the declared-field set is per topic, with `approvalUrl` declared only for the emailed four;
  - `approval-requested-notification.integration.test.ts`;
  - `approval-decision-outcome-notification.integration.test.ts` (two pins);
  - `reminder-action-link-at-rest.integration.test.ts`: the exact-payload assertion gains `approvalUrl`. Its storage scan, positive control and no-mint assertions are unchanged and green.
- **ADR-0043 `actionLinkUrl` pins:** none. `git grep` finds `actionLinkUrl` only at its definition in `approval-service.ts`, with no caller and no test asserting its relative shape. Wiring the address makes it absolute when an origin resolves, which is what its option always documented.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals test`: 114 files, 1482 tests passed. `typecheck` (with `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging test`: 66 files, 828 tests passed. `typecheck`: exit 0. (Run at `b8ab4808`. The later commit touches only plugin-approvals files.)
- **Ablation** (one time, not committed). With `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the `channels` request in `notify()` was disabled (anchor hit once). The new integration file went 4 failed, 1 passed. The file was restored to the HEAD blob `a372f16a` and `git diff HEAD` was empty. plugin-approvals' vitest aliases `@objectstack/service-messaging` to source, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

## Acceptance notes

- **No mail transport.** On a kernel with no `email` service the `email` channel is not mounted, so messaging refuses that leg as it refuses any unregistered channel. It writes no row, reports a failed outcome to the caller, and logs one `warn` per emit (`channel 'email' is not registered`). The inbox delivery is unaffected. The honest "not configured" reading for a mounted channel over a LogTransport is #30510's, and `email-channel.ts` is not touched here.
- **The docs** (`content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`) describe these notices without naming a channel, so no sentence there became false. A sentence saying they also go by e-mail, and that `OS_BASE_URL` makes the link absolute, would help a reader. It is outside "sentences this PR makes false", so it is left for the seat.
- **Locale coverage:** built-ins are keyed by the catalog's tags (`en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`). A recipient whose locale is a bare `zh` walks `zh`, then the declared fallback, then `en`, so the link line reads in English while the body may be Chinese. That is the same ladder rows already walk.
- **Order of the body's first lines:** the dispatch order puts the signature line before `Fixes`. `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (which wins on conflict) puts `Fixes` immediately after the attribution block. This body follows os-dev.
